exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions of the situations and write sentences using the words in brackets.

items.cue: 🖼️ A picture was lying on the floor.
answers: It had fallen off the wall.

items.cue: ✈️ The couple next to you on the plane were nervous: it was their first flight.
🏘️ You went back to your home town after many years. It wasn’t the same as before.
🎤 Somebody sang a song. You didn’t know it.
🎉 I invited Rachel to the party, but she couldn’t come.
answers: She'd arranged to do something else.
She had arranged to do something else.

items.cue: 🎬 You went to the cinema last night, but you got there late.
🌮 Last year we went to Mexico. It was our first visit.
🤗 I met Daniel last week. It was great to see him again after such a long time.
items.prompt: (I / not / see / him / for five years)
answers: I hadn't seen him for five years.

items.cue: 🥪 I offered my friends something to eat, but they weren’t hungry.
🎾 Sam played tennis yesterday and wasn’t very good: it was his first game ever.

exercises.instruction: Each description lists events in the order they happened: (a) before (b), (b) before (c), and so on. Use them to complete the paragraph. The paragraph starts with a later event, so sometimes you need the past perfect.

items.cue: 📋 (a) Somebody broke into the office during the night. (b) We arrived at work in the morning. (c) We called the police. ▶ The paragraph starts with (b).
